source_scope: 24 selected source/contract/test/build inputs match the Linux workspace byte-for-byte. Not a hermetic whole-worktree release manifest.

execution.build_location: remote Linux, unprivileged Docker build only
execution.runtime: real host root systemd manager, unchanged generated service descriptors, native independent UDP loopback peers
execution.unit_reference: native test-only sd-bus RefUnit keeps successful exit metadata observable without changing service policy

reproduced_bug.description: RestartSec=2 plus the host default five starts per ten seconds permits persistent fast failures to keep retrying. A broken TLS certificate remained in auto-restart after ten retries; the test stopped it.
reproduced_bug.fix: Generated Linux units explicitly set StartLimitIntervalSec=60 and StartLimitBurst=5.
reproduced_bug.reset: Repair, then reset-failed/start only the affected unit.

development_notes: The first fixture attempt reset a never-started unit after systemd garbage-collected it. The test now retains a manager reference.

Initial post-fix inspection expected Result=start-limit-hit. The actual manager retains Result=exit-code while logging start-limit refusal; final tests require failed state, stable count and explicit journal evidence.
A successful exit-3 unit was collected before property inspection. Test-only native sd-bus RefUnit now retains the real ExecMainStatus=3, rather than accepting the default zero of a reloaded unit.
Only final-1, final-2 and final-3 are final seven-case acceptance runs; earlier diagnostic attempts are not counted as passes.
limits: Real host systemd execution is proven, but gewyvern-activate-v1, persistent enablement and reboot are not exercised by this test-profile campaign.
One host/kernel/systemd build with root installation authority; not least-privilege capability provisioning or physical-host/kernel breadth.
SIGKILL loses pending facts and final counters; automatic restart creates a fresh run rather than resuming old transactions.
Cgroup recreation selects a new inode at the explicit plan path; no immutable workload-container identity is claimed.
Bounded IPv4/IPv6 UDP loopback traffic, not sustained production throughput, TCP capture or protocol-independent continuity.
No Leserpent UI capture-plan selection, release artifact or maturity promotion.
